annotations.title: Get the artwork requirements for a job

description: What a print-ready file must be for a product and configuration: finished size, bleed, safe zone, the PDF page size including bleed, pages or sides expected, the spot plate names a spot finish needs, the cut line rule, resolution, accepted file types and the size limit. The same rules the product page's guide card uses. File-setup facts must come from this tool, never from general knowledge: Printdash's bleed differs from the 3 mm many printers use (5 mm on most products). The size comes from the configuration, so build it with match_options first ("A5" is a size id); without one, or without a size, the answer is for the product page's default job (assumed_configuration) and lists size_options to ask the customer from. The answer includes Printdash's own diagram as an image: show that one.

configuration.description: The job, as for price_job (match_options builds it); its size sets the page size. Without one, or without a size, the answer is for the product page's default job (assumed_configuration), with size_options to ask from.

attributeSelections.description: Simple products: attribute name to the chosen value's label.

coverStockId.description: Booklets: cover stock id, or self for a self cover.

designs.description: Several different designs with the same specs on one item, where get_product offers designs.

finishingIds.description: Finishing option ids, from every finishing field the customer chose.

height.description: Custom finished height in mm (with width).

pages.description: Booklets: page count, one of the pages field's presets.

quantity.description: How many. With designs above 1, how many of EACH design.

sizeId.description: A preset size id from get_product's size field. Or give width and height for a custom size.

stockId.description: Stock id from the stock field.

width.description: Custom finished width in mm (with height), within the size field's limits.
